parent_channels.name: Arrival, Disclosure, and Transmission

subchannels.name: Arriving Proof
subchannels.scene_or_process: A messenger-borne disclosure comes into a waiting community and makes what was hidden manifest.
subchannels.active_motifs: coming into presence `ء ت ي:B001/m01`; arrival `ج ي ء:B001/m01`; manifest proof `ب ي ن:B004/m01`; message bearer `ر س ل:B002/m01`; bringing forward `ج ي ء:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The two coming-roots supply approach and achieved arrival, while the messenger carries the disclosed content and البينة names its unveiled state. Bringing is therefore both motion toward recipients and transfer into public intelligibility.

subchannels.name: Ordered, Purified Sheets
subchannels.scene_or_process: Written sheets are arranged in a following sequence and presented in a purified state.
subchannels.active_motifs: ordered following `ت ل و:B001/m01`; written sheet `ص ح ف:B002/m01`; removal of defilement `ط ه ر:B001/m01`; carried message `ر س ل:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The surface recitation rests on a lexical image of one item following another. Pages, message, and purification form a controlled transmission scene in which both sequence and medium are made fit for reception.

subchannels.name: Signs, Waymarks, and Beacons
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler or hearer is oriented by signs that reveal meaning, mark a route, or shine from a distance.
subchannels.active_motifs: explanatory sign `ب ي ن:B005/m01`; identifying sign `ء م ر:B005/m01`; road waymark `ء م ر:B005/m02`; beacon `ن و ر:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: بيان makes meaning legible, أمارة fixes a recognizable marker, and the beacon extends recognition across distance. The surface proof thus resonates with practical navigation: disclosure is something by which a course can be found.

subchannels.name: Distorted Reading and False Attribution
subchannels.scene_or_process: A written or spoken transmission is misread, converted into a false statement, and attached to someone as an accusation.
subchannels.active_motifs: textual misreading `ص ح ف:B005/m01`; false following statement `ت ل و:B009/m01`; unattributed report `ر س ل:B011/m03`; accusation of unbelief `ك ف ر:B006/m01`; deficient judgment `ف ك ك:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The channel reverses orderly transmission. A page is read wrongly, the resulting utterance becomes false, and attribution hardens into accusation; lax judgment explains how the communicative chain loses integrity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Something remote, concealed, or merely potential crosses into presence and becomes communicable.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 98:1-4 center on تأتي, رسول, صحفا, كتب, جاءت, and البينة.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Arrival expands from revealed proof into route markers, answering voices, and failures of reading.

parent_channels.name: Written Form and Documentary Force

subchannels.name: From Broad Sheet to Bound Codex
subchannels.scene_or_process: A broad writable surface receives script, is joined at its edges, and becomes a collected book.
subchannels.active_motifs: broad surface `ص ح ف:B001/m01`; written page `ص ح ف:B002/m01`; gathered codex `ص ح ف:B003/m01`; stitching and joining `ك ت ب:B001/m01`; inscription `ك ت ب:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The document is reconstructed materially: breadth provides the sheet, writing fills it, joining closes it, and collected sheets produce the codex. The surface books therefore retain a latent craft image of assembled textual bodies.

subchannels.name: Decree, Upright Record, and Appraisal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A written statement acquires normative force and is assessed as straight, valuable, or authoritative.
subchannels.active_motifs: prescribed decree `ك ت ب:B003/m01`; standing value `ق و م:B010/m01`; straightness `ق و م:B008/m01`; written explanation `ب ي ن:B005/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Writing moves beyond storage into prescription. The record stands because it is both normatively straight and open to appraisal, while بيان supplies the act by which its intended meaning is set out.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Marks are joined into durable textual objects that can state, value, and bind.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 98:1-4 and 98:6 repeatedly invoke الكتاب, كتب, and صحفا.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same lexical field moves from physical stitching to appraisal and enforceable decree.

parent_channels.name: Devotion, Uprightness, and Purification

subchannels.name: Undivided Worship
subchannels.scene_or_process: Worship is directed to one deity through obedience and an allotment withheld from partners.
subchannels.active_motifs: deity and worship `ء ل ه:B001/m01`; worshipful service `ع ب د:B003/m01`; commanded obedience `ء م ر:B002/m01`; obedient religion `د ي ن:B001/m01`; unshared devotion `خ ل ص:B004/m01`; obedient disposition `ر ض و:B006/m01`; obedient disposition `ر ض ي:B004/m01`; partner-making `ش ر ك:B002/m01`; lowered submission `ك ف ر:B014/m01`; willing submission `ك و ن:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The central act is exclusive direction: service and دين are assigned without a partner. The latent image of bodily lowering intensifies this orientation, while partnership marks the precise relation being refused.

subchannels.name: Upright Prayer
subchannels.scene_or_process: A worshipper turns toward a chosen direction, stands straight, and establishes ritual prayer.
subchannels.active_motifs: directional inclination `ح ن ف:B002/m01`; standing posture `ق و م:B002/m01`; straight alignment `ق و م:B008/m01`; ritual prayer `ص ل و:B003/m01`; worship place `ص ل و:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Inclination is not aimless bending but directed reorientation. Standing and straightness convert that turn into stable posture, and prayer gives the posture its repeated ritual form and architectural setting.

subchannels.name: Purified Character and Righteous Work
subchannels.scene_or_process: Defilement is removed from the self, growth is made clean, and intentional work repairs what is wrong.
subchannels.active_motifs: moral purification `ط ه ر:B005/m01`; purity and increase `ز ك و:B002/m01`; filtering refinement `خ ل ص:B001/m01`; repair and righteousness `ص ل ح:B001/m01`; intentional work `ع م ل:B001/m01`; moral good `خ ي ر:B001/m01`; expiation `ك ف ر:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Cleansing, growth, repair, and work form one ethical process: contamination is removed, capacity develops, and the resulting action restores fitness. Expiation supplies the remedial counterpart when action has incurred a stain.

subchannels.name: Invocation, Amen, and Blessing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A worshipper names the divine, addresses the lord, asks for blessing, and seals the utterance with amen.
subchannels.active_motifs: divine invocation `ء ل ه:B002/m01`; amen response `ء م ن:B003/m01`; supplication and blessing `ص ل و:B002/m01`; lordship addressed `ر ب ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Naming opens the address, lordship identifies the addressee, supplication carries the request, and amen supplies the answering assent. The result is a compact call-and-response ritual.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A person is directed, straightened, and cleansed for undivided service.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 98:2 and 98:5 explicitly join الله, مطهرة, يعبدوا, مخلصين, حنفاء, الصلاة, and الزكاة.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Ritual posture extends into lowered submission, purification media, and places built for worship.

parent_channels.name: Conviction, Awe, and Acceptance

subchannels.name: Conviction and Learned Discernment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claim is inwardly assented to and interpreted through knowledgeable, delegated judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: belief and assent `ء م ن:B002/m01`; knowledge carried by fear-language `خ ش ي:B002/m01`; learned religious guide `ر ب ب:B003/m01`; delegated adjudication `د ي ن:B007/m01`; denial `ك ف ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Belief is presented as a settled cognitive act rather than mere safety. Learned interpretation and delegated judgment give it a disciplined frame, while denial provides the opposing refusal to assent.

subchannels.name: Security Held Beside Awe
subchannels.scene_or_process: Trust establishes safety while reverent fear and alarm keep the subject alert.
subchannels.active_motifs: security and trust `ء م ن:B001/m01`; awe and apprehension `خ ش ي:B001/m01`; fear after separation `ف ر ق:B009/m01`; skittish aversion `ن و ر:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Security and fear are not simple opposites here. Trust supplies a stable relation, while awe, alarm, and skittish recoil regulate approach to what carries authority or danger.

subchannels.name: Acceptance and Mutual Satisfaction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Approval moves from individual contentment to reciprocal satisfaction between parties.
subchannels.active_motifs: acceptance `ر ض و:B001/m01`; abundant satisfaction `ر ض و:B002/m01`; seeking approval `ر ض و:B004/m01`; accepted state `ر ض ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The surface reciprocity is expanded into a process: satisfaction is sought, received, and made abundant. The two morphological branch sets converge on a relation in which approval travels in both directions.

subchannels.name: Selection, Fitness, and Moral Polarity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Persons or actions are compared, chosen, and found fit against an opposing field of evil and ingratitude.
subchannels.active_motifs: excellence and selection `خ ي ر:B002/m01`; choosing `خ ي ر:B003/m01`; fitness `ص ل ح:B003/m01`; worthiness `ء ه ل:B003/m01`; compatibility `ز ك و:B004/m01`; evil `ش ر ر:B001/m01`; ingratitude `ك ف ر:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Evaluation proceeds from comparison to selection and then to demonstrated fitness. Evil and ingratitude are not merely labels but the negative pole against which worthiness, compatibility, and excellence become visible.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Inner judgment settles into belief, guarded fear, evaluation, or contentment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 98:7-8 join آمنوا, خير, رضي/رضوا, خشي, and ربهم.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Interior stance reaches learned discernment, animal skittishness, and negotiated satisfaction.

parent_channels.name: Origination, Existence, and Return

subchannels.name: Formation into Existence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A created being comes into occurrence and is nurtured toward a repaired, viable state.
subchannels.active_motifs: creation and formation `ب ر ء:B001/m01`; occurrence and existence `ك و ن:B001/m01`; nurture and repair `ر ب ب:B002/m01`; activation `ع م ل:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Origination is not an isolated instant. Coming-to-be is followed by nurture, repair, and activation, producing a causal sequence from formation to functioning life.

subchannels.name: Rising Again
subchannels.scene_or_process: Created beings stand into a renewed state whose duration can extend without end.
subchannels.active_motifs: resurrection and rising `ق و م:B013/m01`; renewed creation `ب ر ء:B001/m01`; lasting duration `ء ب د:B001/m01`; permanence `خ ل د:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Standing supplies the motion of return, creation supplies the recreated subject, and the two duration roots extend the resulting state. The scene links beginning and afterlife through renewed existence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What does not yet exist is formed, sustained, and capable of being raised again.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 98:1 uses يكن, 98:6-7 use البرية, and 98:8 places recompensed creatures before their lord.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Creation and resurrection share an image of standing into renewed existence.

parent_channels.name: Accounting, Debt, and Substitution

subchannels.name: Judgment and Recompense
subchannels.scene_or_process: Conduct is judged under a written norm and answered with a corresponding outcome.
subchannels.active_motifs: judgment and accounting `د ي ن:B002/m01`; recompense `ج ز ي:B001/m01`; written decree `ك ت ب:B003/m01`; adjudicative standing `ق و م:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The norm is fixed, the subject stands before it, and judgment produces a matched return. This gives the surface reward an institutional grammar of decree, hearing, and result.

subchannels.name: Debt Collection and Discharge
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claim remains attached until it is collected, fulfilled, or cleared from the debtor.
subchannels.active_motifs: debt `د ي ن:B003/m01`; collection of what is due `ج ز ي:B003/m01`; clearing a right or debt `ب ر ء:B004/m01`; attached liability `ت ل و:B004/m01`; demand to take `ع ن د:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Liability follows the obligated party until collection or release. The same accounting relation can therefore terminate either in payment or in a formal clearing of the outstanding right.

subchannels.name: Tax and Tribute
subchannels.scene_or_process: An authority levies a due, receives tribute, and marks the payer's subordinate position.
subchannels.active_motifs: assessed levy `ء ت ي:B008/m01`; tribute payment `ج ز ي:B004/m01`; lowered submission `ك ف ر:B014/m02`; debt obligation `د ي ن:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Giving becomes compulsory transfer: a due is assessed, collected as tribute, and embedded in a hierarchy. This is the fiscal counterpart of voluntary giving elsewhere in the surah's lexical field.

subchannels.name: Proxy, Sufficiency, and Guarantee
subchannels.scene_or_process: One agent stands in for another, performs the required role, or guarantees that the obligation will be met.
subchannels.active_motifs: substitution `ج ز ي:B002/m01`; sufficiency in another's place `ج ز ي:B002/m02`; substitute office `ق و م:B007/m01`; surety `ك و ن:B003/m01`; delegated agent `ج ر ي:B003/m01`; guarantor `ر ض و:B006/m03`; guarantor `ر ض ي:B004/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Substitution is treated as a functional relation: the proxy occupies a position, the delegate acts, and the guarantor secures completion. Sufficiency names the successful outcome of that replacement.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An obligation is assessed and answered by recompense, payment, discharge, or a substitute.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 98:5 names الدين and 98:8 opens with جزاؤهم.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Eschatological recompense extends into debt collection, tribute, guarantors, and proxy performance.

parent_channels.name: Authority, Office, and Civic Order

subchannels.name: Authority and Stewardship
subchannels.scene_or_process: An office-holder receives authority, supervises affairs, and maintains a governed charge.
subchannels.active_motifs: authority and office `ء م ر:B003/m01`; stewardship `ق و م:B004/m01`; administrative work `ع م ل:B003/m01`; lordship `ر ب ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Command is institutionalized as office, work becomes administration, and standing becomes guardianship. Lordship supplies the highest form of the same relation: ordered care exercised over a charge.

subchannels.name: Enrollment, Roster, and Payroll
subchannels.scene_or_process: Workers are entered into a register, assigned service, and maintained by wage or stipend.
subchannels.active_motifs: enrollment and roster `ك ت ب:B004/m01`; office work `ع م ل:B003/m01`; laboring crew `ع م ل:B006/m01`; wage `ع م ل:B004/m01`; continuing stipend `ج ر ي:B006/m01`; livelihood `ق و م:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The register fixes membership, office assigns function, and recurrent payment sustains the worker. Writing thus operates as a practical technology for coordinating labor and livelihood.

subchannels.name: Covenant and Treaty
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parties bind themselves by covenant and stabilize the relation through mutual assent.
subchannels.active_motifs: covenant `ر ب ب:B011/m01`; communal party `ء ه ل:B001/m01`; partnership `ش ر ك:B001/m01`; mutual satisfaction `ر ض و:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: A covenant gives durable form to a relation among collective parties. Partnership defines shared interest, and reciprocal satisfaction supplies the condition under which the pact can hold.

subchannels.name: Civic Station, Chief, and Crown
subchannels.scene_or_process: A settled polity is arranged around a station, a chief, and visible insignia of rule.
subchannels.active_motifs: city and polity `د ي ن:B006/m01`; established station `ق و م:B006/m01`; located place `ك و ن:B002/m01`; chief of sailors `ر ب ب:B017/m01`; covering crown `ك ف ر:B015/m01`; dignity and service `ع ب د:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Place becomes civic station, station receives leadership, and the crown makes rank visible. The maritime chief extends the hierarchy into a mobile polity whose order must be maintained at sea.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Collective life is organized through offices, records, covenants, and ranked places.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 98:5 supplies command and ordered practice, while 98:8 supplies lordship and station-like nearness.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The field reaches payrolls, civic enrollment, coronation, and maritime command.

parent_channels.name: Affiliation, Household, and Social Placement

subchannels.name: People, Crowd, and Faction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Individuals gather into a people, a dense crowd, a faction, or a named group.
subchannels.active_motifs: affiliated people `ء ه ل:B001/m01`; people as collective `ق و م:B001/m01`; mass of people `ج ن ن:B013/m01`; large gathered companies `ر ب ب:B004/m01`; faction or flock `ف ر ق:B005/m01`; grouped companies `ع د ن:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The channel ranges from affiliation by أهل to the visual density of a crowd. Faction and grouped companies show how a collective can be internally organized or split into bounded bodies.

subchannels.name: Marriage, Affinity, and Caregiving
subchannels.scene_or_process: Marriage creates an affinity network containing spouses, stepchildren, caregivers, and loving obligation.
subchannels.active_motifs: marriage and household `ء ه ل:B002/m01`; in-law affinity `ش ر ك:B003/m01`; stepchild `ر ب ب:B005/m01`; caregiver `ر ب ب:B005/m02`; loving relation `ر ض و:B006/m02`; loving relation `ر ض ي:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Partnership is recast as kinship, and lordly nurture contracts into the intimate work of raising a child from an earlier union. Love gives the resulting household relation an affective rather than merely legal bond.

subchannels.name: Hospitality and Familiar Settlement
subchannels.scene_or_process: An inhabited place receives a newcomer and turns unfamiliar presence into welcome and calm.
subchannels.active_motifs: inhabited familiarity `ء ه ل:B004/m01`; welcome `ء ه ل:B005/m01`; ease through familiarity `ر س ل:B007/m01`; staying attachment `خ ل د:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Habitation supplies the setting, welcome performs admission, and repeated familiarity settles the guest into attachment. The scene is the social inverse of remoteness and wild recoil.

subchannels.name: Outsider, Distant Kin, and Aversion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A newcomer remains socially distant and can be met with the recoil associated with wild creatures.
subchannels.active_motifs: stranger and newcomer `ء ت ي:B006/m01`; distant kin `ب ع د:B005/m01`; remote settlement `ك ف ر:B012/m01`; wild aversion from humans `ء ب د:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Distance is social before it is spatial: kin become remote, the settlement lies beyond familiar bounds, and the outsider evokes animal-like flight. The cluster gives exclusion a bodily image of recoil.

subchannels.name: Servitude and Lower Rank
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person is placed under ownership, compelled into service, and ranked beneath others.
subchannels.active_motifs: slave `ع ب د:B001/m01`; enslavement `ع ب د:B004/m01`; subjugation and ownership `د ي ن:B004/m01`; lower social class `ت ح ت:B002/m01`; distant social rank `ب ع د:B005/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Ownership defines the relation, enslavement enforces it, and "below" converts hierarchy into spatial rank. This latent social frame sharply contrasts with voluntary worship in the surface-primary devotional channel.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Persons are located within households, crowds, ranks, or the margins outside them.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 98:1 and 98:6 distinguish أهل الكتاب and المشركين, while 98:7-8 treat collective human outcomes.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Affiliation expands into stepfamilies, hospitality, distant kin, wild aversion, and underclass position.

parent_channels.name: Partnership, Accord, and Feud

subchannels.name: Coownership and Exclusive Allotment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A resource is shared among partners, divided into portions, and sometimes reserved exclusively for one party.
subchannels.active_motifs: coownership `ش ر ك:B001/m01`; exclusive allotment `خ ل ص:B004/m02`; interval between shares `ب ي ن:B002/m01`; paired share `ز ك و:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Partnership creates the common holding, "between" structures its internal division, pairing establishes matched portions, and exclusive allotment removes one portion from the shared pool.

subchannels.name: Consultation and Reconciliation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parties deliberate, choose a course, and remove mutual aversion through reciprocal assent.
subchannels.active_motifs: counsel `ء م ر:B007/m01`; mutual satisfaction `ر ض و:B003/m01`; reconciliation `ص ل ح:B002/m01`; choosing `خ ي ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Counsel opens alternatives, selection identifies a course, and mutual satisfaction converts it into accord. Reconciliation names the outcome: the prior state of alienation has been removed.

subchannels.name: Bond, Feud, and Peace
subchannels.scene_or_process: A connective social bond is strained into enmity and can be repaired into peace.
subchannels.active_motifs: connective bond `ب ي ن:B003/m01`; close friendship `خ ل ص:B007/m01`; feud `ن و ر:B007/m01`; enmity `ب ع د:B010/m01`; dispute `ش ر ر:B011/m01`; peacemaking `ص ل ح:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The same "between" that links parties becomes the space in which feud operates. Enmity stretches the relation apart, dispute activates it, and reconciliation restores the bond.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Shared relations are allocated, negotiated, repaired, or broken by hostility.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 98:4 names dispersal and 98:8 names reciprocal satisfaction, with المشركين providing a surface partnership-form.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The field moves from coowned property to consultation and then to feud as a damaged connective bond.

parent_channels.name: Unbinding, Separation, and Release

subchannels.name: Opening the Interlock
subchannels.scene_or_process: Joined parts are opened, a captive or pledge is freed, and the separated pieces continue independently.
subchannels.active_motifs: opening an interlock `ف ك ك:B001/m01`; freeing captive or pledge `ف ك ك:B002/m01`; disengaging and continuing `ف ك ك:B003/m01`; separating parts `ف ر ق:B001/m01`; split opening `ف ر ق:B004/m01`; boundary separation `ب ي ن:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Release begins as mechanics: pressure is removed from an interlock and its parts come apart. Captivity and pledge then inherit the same operation, making freedom a social form of unfastening.

subchannels.name: Contractual Manumission
subchannels.scene_or_process: An enslaved person enters a written installment agreement that ends ownership and clears the claim.
subchannels.active_motifs: emancipation contract `ك ت ب:B005/m01`; enslaved person `ع ب د:B001/m01`; clearing the right `ب ر ء:B004/m01`; escape from constraint `خ ل ص:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The written contract transforms release into a staged legal process. Payment or performance clears the owner's right, and the formerly bound person exits the relation.

subchannels.name: Dispersal, Banishment, and Desertion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A group scatters, is driven away, and leaves behind an abandoned relation or place.
subchannels.active_motifs: scattering `ف ر ق:B002/m01`; moving apart `ف ر ق:B016/m01`; dispersal in many directions `ع ب د:B010/m01`; active distancing `ب ع د:B003/m01`; banishment or curse `ب ع د:B004/m01`; abandonment `ت ل و:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Separation becomes a sequence: cohesion fails, members move in divergent directions, and distance hardens into exclusion. Abandonment supplies the state left after the movement is complete.

subchannels.name: Irrevocable Marital Parting
subchannels.scene_or_process: Courtship or marriage is terminated by a separation whose legal effect cannot simply be reversed.
subchannels.active_motifs: irrevocable divorce `ب ي ن:B012/m01`; courtship after marriage `ر س ل:B009/m01`; contractual discharge `ب ر ء:B004/m02`; repudiation `ك ف ر:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The household bond is first a legal relation and then a terminated one. Repudiation performs the break, discharge clears the obligation, and the divorce branch defines the resulting boundary as final.

subchannels.name: Exoneration and Disavowal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person separates from blame, a claim, or a condemned affiliation and emerges cleared.
subchannels.active_motifs: disassociation and innocence `ب ر ء:B002/m01`; disavowal `ك ف ر:B005/m01`; moral cleansing `ط ه ر:B005/m01`; deliverance `خ ل ص:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Exoneration is modeled as clean separation. The accused or affiliated subject repudiates the attachment, is purified of its residue, and exits the claim in a state of innocence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A fastening, obligation, affiliation, or claim is opened so that its parties can part.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 98:1 uses منفكين and 98:4 uses تفرق and بعد.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Physical unfastening extends into manumission, debt release, divorce, banishment, and exoneration.

parent_channels.name: Abiding, Settlement, and Refuge

subchannels.name: Eternal Garden Residence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Inhabitants remain in a cultivated abode whose residence and duration do not end.
subchannels.active_motifs: eternity `ء ب د:B001/m01`; permanence `خ ل د:B001/m01`; fixed residence `ع د ن:B001/m01`; garden `ج ن ن:B003/m01`; staying `ر ب ب:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Garden supplies the enclosed living place, عدن and staying make it a settled abode, and the two duration motifs remove temporal limit. The scene is both cultivated space and permanent habitation.

subchannels.name: Secure Station and Refuge
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person reaches a fixed station, enters a concealed shelter, and remains there in safety.
subchannels.active_motifs: secure trust `ء م ن:B001/m01`; station `ق و م:B006/m01`; hiding place `ج ن ن:B017/m01`; located place `ك و ن:B002/m01`; lasting stay `ء ب د:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Station and place supply stability, the hiding place supplies protection, and trust names the resulting condition. Staying converts temporary refuge into residence.

subchannels.name: Inhabited and Deserted Places
subchannels.scene_or_process: Familiar habitation is contrasted with a remote dwelling emptied of its people.
subchannels.active_motifs: inhabited familiarity `ء ه ل:B004/m01`; deserted dwelling `ء ب د:B003/m01`; remote settlement `ك ف ر:B012/m01`; spatial distance `ب ع د:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Inhabitation is a social quality of place, not merely occupancy. When people withdraw, familiarity becomes desolation and distance turns the abandoned settlement into a remote margin.

subchannels.name: Burial and Enclosed Rest
subchannels.scene_or_process: The ground is struck or opened, the body is concealed, and the burial place is bounded by earth or wall.
subchannels.active_motifs: burial and interment `ج ن ن:B009/m01`; striking the ground `ع د ن:B006/m01`; mountain recess `ك ف ر:B013/m01`; low enclosing wall `ك ف ر:B013/m02`; concealment `ج ن ن:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Ground-striking supplies the action, recess and wall shape the enclosure, and concealment produces the final state. The garden root's enclosing function reaches here into the grave as another held interior.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A place holds its occupants through permanence, security, familiarity, or concealment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 98:8 joins جنات عدن, خالدين, أبدا, عند, and ربهم.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The enduring garden is mirrored by hidden shelters, deserted dwellings, and the enclosed place of burial.

parent_channels.name: Relational Space and Grammar

subchannels.name: Between, Near, Below, and After
subchannels.scene_or_process: Entities are placed relative to one another by interval, proximity, vertical order, and posteriority.
subchannels.active_motifs: interval between `ب ي ن:B002/m01`; nearness `ع ن د:B004/m01`; below `ت ح ت:B001/m01`; after `ب ع د:B002/m01`; lateral divergence `ع ن د:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The relations form a compact coordinate system. Between and near establish horizontal relation, below establishes vertical order, and after converts the same positioning logic into time.

subchannels.name: Gap, Tract, and Expanse
subchannels.scene_or_process: A wide interval opens into a traversable tract or broad surface.
subchannels.active_motifs: wide gap `ب ي ن:B006/m01`; tract or region `ب ي ن:B007/m01`; distance `ب ع د:B001/m01`; emphatic remoteness `ب ع د:B006/m01`; broad plane `ص ح ف:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Separation is spatialized at increasing scale: gap becomes distance, distance becomes tract, and the tract spreads into a broad plane. The channel supplies the landscape through which later road and water scenes move.

subchannels.name: Possession, Relative Reference, and Demonstration
subchannels.scene_or_process: A referent is identified as a possessor, linked by a relative expression, or pointed out demonstratively.
subchannels.active_motifs: possession and attribution `ذ و و:B001/m01`; relative connector `ذ و و:B002/m01`; demonstrative pointer `ذ و و:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Possession anchors a relation to an owner, the relative form carries that relation into a clause, and the demonstrative fixes a referent in discourse. Pointing is therefore a grammatical form of spatial orientation.

subchannels.name: Inquiry, Duration, and Quantification
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker asks about an event, locates it within a span, and frames its frequency or amount.
subchannels.active_motifs: interrogative compound `ذ و و:B004/m01`; simultaneity or "during" `ب ي ن:B010/m01`; recurring interval `ب ع د:B007/m01`; appointed time `ء م ر:B005/m03`; quantifying preposition `ر ب ب:B015/m01`; distinct kinds and faces `ف ر ق:B015/m01`; intermediate quality `ب ي ن:B011/m01`; softened intermediate phoneme `ب ي ن:B011/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Interrogation opens a variable, temporal expressions delimit its span, and quantification constrains recurrence or amount. The "between-between" branch also shows gradation operating inside phonological and qualitative categories.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Meaning is organized by relative position, interval, reference, and temporal or quantitative framing.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 98:4 uses بعد, 98:8 uses عند and تحت, and 98:5 and 98:8 use ذلك.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Concrete spacing becomes pronoun reference, interrogation, softened phonology, and quantification.

parent_channels.name: Roads, Navigation, and Sequence

subchannels.name: Road, Fork, and Smoothed Track
subchannels.scene_or_process: A route is prepared, grooved by passage, divided at a fork, and followed in a chosen direction.
subchannels.active_motifs: road and junction `ء ت ي:B010/m01`; road groove `ش ر ك:B005/m01`; traveled road `ع م ل:B011/m01`; road parting `ف ر ق:B006/m01`; smoothed road `ع ب د:B005/m01`; directional inclination `ح ن ف:B002/m01`; reached destination `خ ل ص:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Repeated passage smooths and grooves the track, the fork divides available movement, and directional inclination selects a branch. The road is thus both material trace and structured choice.

subchannels.name: Coastal Navigation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A maritime chief follows coastal markers through a route exposed to incoming water.
subchannels.active_motifs: chief of sailors `ر ب ب:B017/m01`; coast `ع د ن:B003/m01`; road waymark `ء م ر:B005/m02`; beacon `ن و ر:B005/m01`; route junction `ء ت ي:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Captain, coast, waymark, beacon, and route form a complete navigation scene. It joins civic leadership to landscape orientation: command at sea depends on reading fixed signs along a changing edge.

subchannels.name: Customary Course
subchannels.scene_or_process: Repeated conduct settles into a recognized course, habit, or social way.
subchannels.active_motifs: customary course `ج ر ي:B002/m01`; custom and established practice `د ي ن:B005/m01`; following remainder `ت ل و:B003/m01`; affair or condition `ء م ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: A course first describes movement, then becomes the repeated path of conduct. Remainder and circumstance show how prior action leaves a line that later practice continues to follow.

subchannels.name: Procession and Succession
subchannels.scene_or_process: Members advance in ordered succession, each following the one before it.
subchannels.active_motifs: sequential following `ت ل و:B001/m01`; succession `ش ر ك:B007/m01`; successive groups `ر س ل:B005/m01`; recurring intervals `ب ع د:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Following supplies local order, successive groups scale it into a procession, and intervals give the sequence rhythm. Succession preserves continuity while still distinguishing each member.

subchannels.name: Gait, Second Position, and Stoppage
subchannels.scene_or_process: A trained animal moves with an easy gait, takes a ranked position in a race, and can finally tire or stop.
subchannels.active_motifs: easy gait `ر س ل:B003/m01`; foreleg gait `ء ت ي:B009/m01`; work-ready mount `ع م ل:B008/m01`; travelers on foot `ع م ل:B012/m01`; second horse `ص ل و:B006/m01`; quick running `ع ب د:B009/m02`; stopping from exhaustion `ق و م:B016/m01`; breakdown of the mount `ع ب د:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Aptitude and gait produce sustained movement, the race assigns relative position, and exhaustion terminates the course. The scene captures motion as a progression from readiness through performance to stoppage.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Movement is ordered by routes, successive positions, customary courses, and destinations.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; تأتي, جاءت, يتلوا, and تجري provide surface motion, while the road and gait scenes are lexical extensions.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel includes road grooves, coastal pilots, second-place horses, and the exhaustion that stops travel.

parent_channels.name: Hydrology, Coast, and Containment

subchannels.name: Rivers, Canals, and Widening Channels
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water follows a directed course through a channel that can widen and continue downstream.
subchannels.active_motifs: flowing current `ج ر ي:B001/m01`; river `ن ه ر:B001/m01`; watercourse direction `ء ت ي:B004/m01`; channel widening `ن ه ر:B003/m01`; dispatched flow `ر س ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Direction determines the course, flow animates it, widening gives the channel capacity, and dispatch supplies release from an upstream source. The surface river is thus both object and continuing process.

subchannels.name: Flood, Runoff, and Coast
subchannels.scene_or_process: Incoming floodwater runs along a side channel and reaches a coastal edge.
subchannels.active_motifs: incoming flood `ء ت ي:B005/m01`; heavy rain from a cloud `ع ن د:B003/m02`; coast `ع د ن:B003/m01`; dark vastness `ك ف ر:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Flood supplies force, side-flow supplies direction, coast supplies the receiving boundary, and dark vastness supplies scale. Together they form a shoreline scene under pressure from arriving water.

subchannels.name: Pool, Basin, and Reservoir
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water collects in a depression or broad vessel and is held as a usable reserve.
subchannels.active_motifs: pool `ج ي ء:B002/m01`; small water basin `ص ح ف:B004/m02`; abundant stored water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; low enclosing wall `ك ف ر:B013/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Depression receives the water, breadth gives the basin capacity, and abundance turns collection into reserve. The low wall supplies a practical boundary that keeps the stored water in place.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Water is directed, widened, pooled, or released across a landscape.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 98:8 presents gardens with rivers flowing beneath them.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The river scene extends to floodfronts, shorelines, reservoirs, and broad basins.

parent_channels.name: Growth, Fertility, and Sustenance

subchannels.name: Seed, Increase, and Yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: A farmer covers seed, growth increases under protection, and the crop gives a yield.
subchannels.active_motifs: farmer covering seed `ك ف ر:B008/m01`; growth `ز ك و:B001/m01`; agricultural yield `ء ت ي:B007/m01`; increase and blessing `ء م ر:B004/m01`; protective husk `ك ف ر:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Covering is productive here: seed is hidden so that increase can occur. The husk preserves development, and yield is the moment when concealed growth becomes available.

subchannels.name: Garden, Thicket, Pasture, and Blossom
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dense vegetation forms a garden whose plants provide pasture and visible blossom.
subchannels.active_motifs: thick vegetation `ج ن ن:B011/m01`; evergreen plant `ر ب ب:B012/m01`; pasture plant `ص ل و:B009/m01`; blossom `ن و ر:B004/m01`; named plant `ش ر ر:B012/m01`; scattered vegetation `ف ر ق:B014/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Vegetation moves from scattered plants to thicket and garden, while pasture gives it use and blossom gives it seasonal visibility. Density and dispersion are complementary phases of the same ecology.

subchannels.name: Lactation, Fertile Animals, and Herd
subchannels.scene_or_process: A recently delivered animal remains near shelter, gives milk, and rejoins a managed herd.
subchannels.active_motifs: milk flow `ر س ل:B006/m01`; newly delivered ewe `ر ب ب:B009/m01`; annually fertile female `ء ب د:B004/m01`; wild cattle herd `ر ب ب:B014/m01`; pregnant animal leaving the herd `ف ر ق:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Parturition changes herd position: the pregnant animal separates, the newly delivered ewe remains close for milk, and fertility returns the animal to recurring production. Herd and milk connect reproduction to sustenance.

subchannels.name: Ripening, Drying, and Withering
subchannels.scene_or_process: Produce matures, dries under exposure, and can end as husk or shriveled fruit.
subchannels.active_motifs: shriveled date `خ ش ي:B004/m01`; sun-drying `ش ر ر:B002/m01`; husk `ك ف ر:B010/m01`; yield before drying `ء ت ي:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Yield marks fullness, exposure removes moisture, and husk or shriveled fruit marks the terminal state. The sequence can describe preservation or failed fertility depending on what remains edible.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Hidden potential becomes plant, offspring, milk, or harvest through increase and release.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 98:5 names الزكاة and 98:8 names gardens and flowing rivers.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Growth reaches seed-covering farmers, lactating ewes, wild herds, husks, and sun-dried fruit.

parent_channels.name: Covering, Light, and Sky-Time

subchannels.name: Concealment, Night, and Dark Vastness
subchannels.scene_or_process: Covering thickens into night and makes a broad region difficult to see.
subchannels.active_motifs: concealment `ج ن ن:B001/m01`; night `ج ن ن:B002/m01`; covering `ك ف ر:B001/m01`; dark vastness `ك ف ر:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Covering is the operation, concealment the immediate state, night the temporal setting, and dark vastness the enlarged landscape. The same lexical motion hides objects and whole horizons.

subchannels.name: Fire, Illumination, and Sparks
subchannels.scene_or_process: Heat kindles visible fire, throws sparks, and becomes a source of illumination or warning.
subchannels.active_motifs: illumination `ن و ر:B001/m01`; fire `ن و ر:B002/m01`; sparks `ش ر ر:B003/m01`; heat and burning `ص ل و:B001/m01`; beacon `ن و ر:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Burning and heat generate sparks, while light converts combustion into visibility. The beacon gives the fire a directional function: it warns or guides beyond its immediate heat.

subchannels.name: Daylight, Meridian, and Calendar Edge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Day advances toward noon while a calendar unit approaches its final night or day.
subchannels.active_motifs: daylight `ن ه ر:B002/m01`; noon and meridian `ق و م:B017/m01`; final night or day of a month `ب ر ء:B006/m01`; appointed time `ء م ر:B005/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Noon locates the day spatially through the sun's height, while the month's last day locates a larger cycle at its boundary. Appointed time unifies both scales as measured arrival.

subchannels.name: Layered Cloud and Overcast
subchannels.scene_or_process: Moisture gathers into layered cloud, spreads a covering overhead, and releases side-running rain.
subchannels.active_motifs: layered cloud `ر ب ب:B008/m01`; cloud mass `ن ه ر:B008/m01`; covering canopy `ك ف ر:B001/m01`; heavy rain `ع ن د:B003/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Cloud is built as a massed covering rather than an isolated object. Layering darkens the sky, and released rain converts the overhead accumulation into lateral flow on the ground.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Visibility changes as things are covered, illuminated, exposed by day, or massed into cloud.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 98:6 names fire and 98:8 names rivers and permanence within a garden landscape.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The field reaches night, meridian shadow, month endings, layered cloud, and sparks.

parent_channels.name: Reproduction, Maturation, and Bodily Cycles

subchannels.name: Fetus, Birth, and Offspring
subchannels.scene_or_process: A fetus remains concealed, birth opens the body, and offspring emerge under the pressure of the pelvic flank.
subchannels.active_motifs: fetus `ج ن ن:B007/m01`; offspring `ت ل و:B006/m01`; pelvic flank at birth `ص ل و:B005/m01`; parturition `ف ك ك:B007/m01`; newborn lamb `ء م ر:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Concealment supplies gestation, opening supplies delivery, and the pelvic motif supplies bodily mechanics. Offspring and lamb name the resulting new life.

subchannels.name: Estrus, Pairing, and Herd Separation
subchannels.scene_or_process: An animal enters estrus, pairs, and temporarily separates from the herd during pregnancy.
subchannels.active_motifs: estrus `ء ت ي:B012/m01`; estrus and reproductive opening `ف ك ك:B007/m02`; paired state `ز ك و:B005/m01`; pregnant animal leaving the herd `ف ر ق:B008/m01`; newly delivered ewe `ر ب ب:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Pairing initiates the cycle, pregnancy changes the animal's social position, and delivery returns the scene to fertility and milk. Separation here is a temporary reproductive behavior rather than social rupture.

subchannels.name: Menstrual and Postpartum Clearance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bleeding ceases, washing follows, and an adolescent or postpartum woman returns to a cleared state.
subchannels.active_motifs: menstrual clearance `ب ر ء:B005/m01`; cessation of menstruation `ط ه ر:B002/m01`; washing `ط ه ر:B003/m01`; maiden `ج ر ي:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Cessation marks the biological boundary, washing performs the hygienic transition, and clearance names the restored state. The maiden motif places the process within a broader female life cycle.

subchannels.name: Youth, Freshness, and Old Age
subchannels.scene_or_process: Life begins in fresh youth, intensifies into youthful zeal, and later becomes retrospective old age.
subchannels.active_motifs: beginning of youth `ج ن ن:B014/m01`; youthful freshness `ر ب ب:B009/m02`; youthful zeal `ش ر ر:B010/m01`; period of girlhood `ج ر ي:B004/m02`; aged man saying "I used to" `ك و ن:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Fresh beginning develops into energy and then into remembered past. The elder's repeated "I used to" makes age a grammatical habit of looking back at former vitality.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Bodies pass through conception, birth, fertility, clearance, youth, and age.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the cited roots occur throughout 98:1-8, while their reproductive senses are latent lexical branches.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel includes fetal concealment, estrus, postpartum clearance, youthful zeal, and an elder defined by saying "I used to."

parent_channels.name: Anatomy, Injury, and Recovery

subchannels.name: Frame, Limbs, and Joints
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body is assembled from jaws, chest bones, limbs, joints, and a curved foot.
subchannels.active_motifs: jaws `ف ك ك:B004/m01`; chest bones and rib ends `ج ن ن:B016/m01`; working legs `ع م ل:B010/m01`; working eye `ع م ل:B010/m02`; anatomical separation `ف ر ق:B007/m01`; limb separation `ب ي ن:B008/m01`; curved foot `ح ن ف:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The branches map a load-bearing frame whose parts meet at separable joints. Curvature and separation make bodily alignment visible by showing where the frame can deviate or come apart.

subchannels.name: Pain, Disease, and Wound Discharge
subchannels.scene_or_process: A limb or organ becomes painful, gait fails, and an injured site releases pus.
subchannels.active_motifs: wound pus `ج ي ء:B003/m01`; wound discharge `ج ي ء:B006/m01`; side-flowing blood or vomit `ع ن د:B003/m01`; pain lodged in an organ `ق و م:B019/m01`; leg disease in a sheep `ق و م:B020/m01`; dislocation `ف ك ك:B005/m01`; gaunt weakness `ف ك ك:B007/m03`; calamity or death `ء ت ي:B011/m01`; last breath `ت ل و:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Pain first settles in a part, then alters stance or gait, while dislocation and suppuration reveal structural injury. Calamity and last breath mark the extreme end of the same bodily decline.

subchannels.name: Convalescence and Release from Illness
subchannels.scene_or_process: Disease loosens, the patient separates from the afflicted state, and ordinary function returns.
subchannels.active_motifs: recovery `ب ر ء:B003/m01`; convalescence `ف ر ق:B010/m01`; escape from constraint `خ ل ص:B002/m01`; cleansing wash `ط ه ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Recovery is expressed as separation: illness releases its hold and the patient exits it. Washing removes residue, while convalescence names the interval in which restored function becomes stable.

subchannels.name: Dosing and Medicinal Preparation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A remedy is prepared from food or aromatic material, purified, and placed into a child's mouth.
subchannels.active_motifs: oral dosing of a child `ف ك ك:B009/m01`; date-and-fenugreek remedy `ف ر ق:B012/m01`; dried medicinal meat `خ ش ي:B004/m02`; purifying medium `ط ه ر:B004/m01`; camphor `ك ف ر:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Preparation combines drying, cooking, and purification before the medicine is administered orally. The postpartum remedy and camphor broaden treatment from dosing into restorative food and aromatic material.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Bodily parts bear motion and pain, become injured or dislocated, and receive treatment that restores function.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; roots such as فكك, فرق, عمل, برء, and طهر are present, while the anatomical and medical senses are lexical.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The field reaches jaws, ribs, blind-looking eyes, suppurating wounds, oral dosing, and postpartum remedies.

parent_channels.name: Craft, Materials, and Fitted Objects

subchannels.name: Spear and Projectile Assembly
subchannels.scene_or_process: A shaft is fitted to its forward metal component and prepared as a projectile.
subchannels.active_motifs: spearhead fitting `ء م ر:B011/m01`; spear shaft and forepart `ع م ل:B009/m01`; short arrow `ر س ل:B011/m01`; chest-bone forepart analogy `ج ن ن:B016/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Shaft and fitted point provide the actual assembly, while short arrow and chest forepart extend it by scale and shape. The shared invariant is a rigid forward member designed to project force.

subchannels.name: Stitching, Strap, Patch, and Knot
subchannels.scene_or_process: Flexible material is stitched, strapped, patched at a weak edge, and secured by a tight knot.
subchannels.active_motifs: stitching and joining `ك ت ب:B001/m01`; cutting and shredding `ش ر ر:B004/m01`; sandal strap `ش ر ك:B004/m01`; vessel-bottom patch `ع د ن:B004/m01`; shoe extension patch `ع د ن:B004/m02`; tar-coated vessel `ع ب د:B005/m02`; tight knot `ر ب ب:B016/m02`; fringe `ش ر ر:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Joining closes a seam, strap and knot hold tension, and a patch adds material where a vessel or shoe needs reinforcement. Fringes show the loose edge that this craft work controls.

subchannels.name: Jewelry, Necklace, and Crown
subchannels.scene_or_process: Small joined pieces become wearable ornaments and, at the highest rank, a crown.
subchannels.active_motifs: earrings and bracelets `خ ل د:B003/m01`; necklace `ر س ل:B011/m02`; crown `ك ف ر:B015/m01`; joining `ك ت ب:B001/m01`; craftspeople `ع م ل:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Joining converts discrete pieces into ornaments that encircle the body. Crown extends the same fitted form into public rank, while the worker motif supplies the maker.

subchannels.name: Fat, Ghee, Syrup, and Concentrate
subchannels.scene_or_process: Animal or food material is rendered, clarified, and concentrated into fat, ghee, or syrup.
subchannels.active_motifs: rendered fat or oil `ء ه ل:B006/m01`; kidney fat `ف ر ق:B013/m01`; clarified butter `خ ل ص:B008/m01`; food residue `خ ل ص:B008/m02`; thick syrup `ر ب ب:B006/m01`; dripping roast fat `ش ر ر:B005/m01`; fragments after biting `ش ر ر:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Heat releases fat, clarification separates usable concentrate from residue, and continued reduction produces syrup-like thickness. The scene is a sequence of material transformation rather than a loose food list.

subchannels.name: Perfume, Kohl, Lime, and Grinding
subchannels.scene_or_process: Aromatic or cosmetic material is ground on a slab, smoked or mixed into pigment, and applied to skin or hair.
subchannels.active_motifs: perfume slab `ع ب د:B012/m01`; grinding stone `ص ل و:B008/m01`; kohl smoke `ن و ر:B008/m01`; tattoo pigment `ن و ر:B008/m02`; depilatory lime `ن و ر:B009/m01`; mustache fullness `ع د ن:B007/m01`; purifying medium `ط ه ر:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Grinding prepares the aromatic base, smoke or mineral supplies pigment, and lime alters body hair. Mustache fullness gives the grooming scene its bodily target, while purification governs preparation and application.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Separate materials are cut, joined, fitted, ornamented, or processed into usable objects.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; الكتاب, عملوا, مطهرة, and نار provide the active roots, while the craft scenes are latent.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The field reconstructs spear assembly, patched vessels, jewelry, rendered fat, perfume grinding, and body grooming.

parent_channels.name: Strategy, Capture, and Contest

subchannels.name: Ambush, Snare, and Lure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hunter hides in a blind, lures prey from shelter, and catches it in a snare or trap.
subchannels.active_motifs: snare `ش ر ك:B006/m01`; trap `ص ل و:B004/m01`; hunter's blind `ب ر ء:B007/m01`; concealed refuge `ج ن ن:B017/m01`; luring an animal from its burrow `خ ي ر:B006/m01`; sudden snatch `ن ه ر:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Concealment protects the hunter, lure initiates movement, and trap converts that movement into capture. The snatch is the abrupt terminal action of the same tactical sequence.

subchannels.name: Small Prey, Serpent, and Blindness
subchannels.scene_or_process: Small harmful creatures inhabit concealed ground and are pursued or detected despite impaired sight.
subchannels.active_motifs: serpent `ج ن ن:B012/m01`; blind burrowing rodent `خ ل د:B005/m01`; gnat-like irritant `ش ر ر:B009/m01`; lure from a burrow `خ ي ر:B006/m01`; intact-looking blind eye `ق و م:B021/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Burrow and concealment define the habitat, serpent and irritant define danger, and blindness complicates pursuit or perception. The intact eye with lost sight gives a bodily analogue to the unseen movement underground.

subchannels.name: Shielding and Structural Cover
subchannels.scene_or_process: A rigid cover receives force and is held by a standing support.
subchannels.active_motifs: shield `ج ن ن:B008/m01`; covering `ك ف ر:B001/m01`; standing support `ق و م:B012/m02`; strength and solidity `ع ب د:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Covering becomes defensive when it is rigid, supported, and strong enough to receive impact. The scene turns concealment into active protection.

subchannels.name: Rivalry, Wrestling, and Overcoming
subchannels.scene_or_process: Matched opponents engage, resist, and seek to overcome one another.
subchannels.active_motifs: overcoming in reciprocal action `ج ز ي:B005/m01`; resistance and wrestling `ق و م:B014/m01`; matching competition `ج ر ي:B007/m01`; victory in a satisfaction contest `ر ض و:B005/m01`; victory in contest `ر ض ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Matching creates comparable opponents, resistance sustains the encounter, and overcoming produces an asymmetric result. The satisfaction branches preserve the interpersonal setting by describing victory over another claimant.

subchannels.name: Coercion and Rebellion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Pressure forces a subject toward disobedience, and the subject may harden into opposition.
subchannels.active_motifs: compulsion `ج ي ء:B005/m01`; coercion into disobedience `ك ف ر:B007/m01`; obstinate opposition `ع ن د:B001/m01`; enmity `ب ع د:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Compulsion applies force, coerced disobedience redirects conduct, and obstinacy makes resistance durable. Enmity is the social state that remains after pressure and rebellion polarize the parties.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Agents seek advantage by hiding, trapping, shielding, competing, or coercing.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; separation, disbelief, and fire supply surface tension, while the tactical scenes are lexical.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel includes hunter blinds, burrowing prey, shields, wrestling, and forced disobedience.

parent_channels.name: Decision, Deliberation, and Extremity

subchannels.name: Counsel and Measured Deliberation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A matter is approached through counsel, slow delivery, comparison, and settled resolve.
subchannels.active_motifs: counsel `ء م ر:B007/m01`; deliberate measured delivery `ر س ل:B004/m01`; resolve `ق و م:B003/m01`; choosing `خ ي ر:B003/m01`; workable avenue `ء ت ي:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Counsel opens the question, measured delivery slows premature action, and comparison selects a workable route. Resolve is the point at which deliberation becomes commitment.

subchannels.name: Penetrating Judgment and Total Commitment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A decision reaches through uncertainty and is carried out with the whole self.
subchannels.active_motifs: decisive effectiveness `ء ت ي:B013/m01`; penetrating judgment `ب ع د:B008/m01`; throwing one's whole self into action `ش ر ر:B007/m01`; quick execution `ع ب د:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Penetration describes the cognitive cut through ambiguity, while total self-commitment and speed describe execution. The scene joins insight to irreversible action.

subchannels.name: Weak Judgment and Divided Opinion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person lacks internal firmness, follows every command, and remains suspended between alternatives.
subchannels.active_motifs: weak-minded follower `ء م ر:B008/m01`; lax judgment `ف ك ك:B006/m01`; divided opinion `ش ر ك:B008/m01`; intermediate quality `ب ي ن:B011/m01`; bad condition `ك و ن:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Weakness prevents a judgment from cohering, divided opinion pulls in more than one direction, and the intermediate state never reaches decisive value. Compliance then comes from instability rather than conviction.

subchannels.name: Futility, No Choice, and Strain
subchannels.scene_or_process: Effort continues after useful options have closed and produces strain without benefit.
subchannels.active_motifs: lack of utility `ب ع د:B009/m01`; no way or choice `ع ن د:B005/m01`; exertion and trouble `ع م ل:B007/m01`; adverse condition `ك و ن:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: No-choice closes the decision space, futility removes expected gain, and effort becomes pure strain. The adverse condition is therefore both the cause and outcome of ineffective action.

subchannels.name: Anger, Regret, and Harsh Rebuke
subchannels.scene_or_process: A grave affair provokes anger, hardens into verbal rebuke, and may end in regret after loss.
subchannels.active_motifs: anger `ء ب د:B009/m01`; anger and offended pride `ع ب د:B008/m01`; regret after loss `ع ب د:B008/m02`; harsh rebuke `ن ه ر:B004/m01`; grave or monstrous affair `ء م ر:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The affair supplies the provocation, anger supplies the immediate state, and rebuke externalizes it in speech. Regret appears when the object of anger or effort is already lost.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A course is weighed, chosen, enacted decisively, weakened by indecision, or driven to an emotional limit.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 98:5 supplies command and 98:4 supplies aftermath, while the decision mechanics are lexical.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Deliberation reaches penetrating judgment, total self-commitment, weak-minded compliance, futility, anger, and rebuke.

parent_channels.name: Work, Wages, Gifts, and Exchange

subchannels.name: Purposeful Work and Performance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Intention activates a task and coordinated participants carry it through as performance.
subchannels.active_motifs: intentional work `ع م ل:B001/m01`; activation and use `ع م ل:B002/m01`; reciprocal performance `ر س ل:B008/m01`; answering voice `ت ل و:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Intention defines the task, activation begins it, and reciprocal performance distributes it across agents. The answering voice gives coordinated work an audible call-and-response form.

subchannels.name: Labor Crew, Wage, and Stipend
subchannels.scene_or_process: A crew performs assigned labor and receives recurring support for its livelihood.
subchannels.active_motifs: manual workers `ع م ل:B006/m01`; wage `ع م ل:B004/m01`; stipend `ج ر ي:B006/m01`; livelihood `ق و م:B009/m01`; enrolled service `ك ت ب:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The crew supplies collective agency, enrollment fixes obligation, and wage or stipend sustains continued service. Livelihood is the stable outcome of repeated compensated work.

subchannels.name: Willing Gift and Welfare
subchannels.scene_or_process: A giver voluntarily presents a benefit in response to another's need.
subchannels.active_motifs: giving and bestowal `ء ت ي:B002/m01`; willing transfer `ر س ل:B010/m01`; generous gift `خ ي ر:B005/m01`; need `ر ب ب:B016/m01`; blessing and benefaction `ر ب ب:B016/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Need supplies the receiving condition, willing transfer preserves the giver's agency, and gift supplies the concrete benefit. Blessing names the surplus value by which the transfer becomes welfare rather than bare exchange.

subchannels.name: Market, Transaction, and Demand
subchannels.scene_or_process: Goods enter a thriving market, parties transact, and demand establishes value.
subchannels.active_motifs: thriving market `ق و م:B018/m01`; reciprocal dealing `ع م ل:B005/m01`; commercial partnership `ش ر ك:B001/m02`; standing appraisal `ق و م:B010/m01`; yield offered for exchange `ء ت ي:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Yield supplies goods, partnership and dealing supply transaction, and demand makes the market "stand" through active exchange. Appraisal converts circulation into an articulated price or value.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Human effort is activated, organized, compensated, or voluntarily transferred as benefit.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 98:5 names giving and 98:7 names عملوا.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Work expands into labor crews, stipends, thriving markets, generous gifts, and social need.

parent_channels.name: Measure, Shape, and Support

subchannels.name: Measure, Equal Weight, and Burden
subchannels.scene_or_process: Material is placed in a known measure, compared against equal weight, and carried as a burden.
subchannels.active_motifs: measure and vessel `ف ر ق:B011/m01`; equal balanced weight `ق و م:B015/m01`; hanging burden `ش ر ر:B006/m02`; bodily stature as measure `ق و م:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Vessel fixes volume, balanced weight fixes equivalence, and stature supplies a natural vertical measure. Burden is the same quantified material once transferred onto a carrier.

subchannels.name: Round Basin, Star Cluster, and Calendar Rim
subchannels.scene_or_process: Circular form is recognized in a broad bowl, a rounded star group, and the closing edge of a month.
subchannels.active_motifs: broad bowl `ص ح ف:B004/m01`; rounded star cluster `ف ك ك:B008/m01`; last night or day of a month `ب ر ء:B006/m01`; containing vessel `ف ر ق:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Bowl and star cluster share a rounded, bounded arrangement, while the calendar branch supplies cyclical closure. The measure-vessel connects shape to practical containment.

subchannels.name: Standing Parts, Handles, and Natural Supports
subchannels.scene_or_process: A larger object or body is held upright by a standing component that functions as leg, handle, or tool.
subchannels.active_motifs: well or pulley support `ق و م:B012/m01`; standing handle or leg `ق و م:B012/m02`; animal legs `ع م ل:B010/m01`; strong structural member `ع ب د:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The same structural role appears in machinery, furniture, tools, and anatomy. A component "stands" because it transfers load and keeps the larger assembly usable.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Objects become usable or comparable through proportion, bounded form, and load-bearing parts.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; قيمة and صحفا supply the roots, while measures, bowls, stars, and handles are lexical.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A measure-vessel, balanced dinar, round star cluster, pulley support, and bodily limb share structural logic.

parent_channels.name: Hidden Beings and Hidden Mind

subchannels.name: Concealed Beings
subchannels.scene_or_process: Unseen beings inhabit a concealed or densely hidden place.
subchannels.active_motifs: jinn as concealed beings `ج ن ن:B005/m01`; concealment `ج ن ن:B001/m01`; hidden place `ج ن ن:B017/m01`; densely enclosed garden `ج ن ن:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The same root organizes agent, setting, and operation: beings are hidden, their place conceals them, and enclosure gives the habitat density. Garden and jinn meet through the invariant of screened interiority.

subchannels.name: Concealed Thought and Derangement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A thought settles inside the heart, remains inaccessible to others, or loses coherence when the mind is covered.
subchannels.active_motifs: hidden heart and thought `ج ن ن:B010/m01`; thought lodged within `خ ل د:B004/m01`; madness as covering of reason `ج ن ن:B006/m01`; weak testimony `ب ي ن:B011/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Lodged thought describes durable interior content, while madness describes the loss of access to ordered reason. Weak testimony is the discourse consequence when an inward state cannot be made reliably clear.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Concealment produces unseen agents, enclosed thought, or loss of mental visibility.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 98:8 uses جنات, while alternate branches of the same root open supernatural and psychological scenes.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Garden enclosure extends through jinn, secret thought, and madness as different modes of being hidden.

parent_channels.name: S1. Mineral Deposit and Inherent Disposition
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Precious material lies fixed at its native source and becomes an analogy for a deeply rooted moral disposition.
parent_channels.active_motifs: original mineral deposit `ع د ن:B002/m01`; innate disposition `ع د ن:B002/m02`; good `خ ي ر:B001/m01`; evil `ش ر ر:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The deposit is valuable because it remains at the place of origin. The same fixedness is transferred to character, where good or evil can be described as something embedded at the source of a person.

parent_channels.name: S2. Gaming Arrows and Shared Lots
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Lot arrows are gathered in a container and used by participants competing over a shared stake.
parent_channels.active_motifs: gaming-arrow container `ر ب ب:B010/m01`; gathered lot arrows `ر ب ب:B010/m02`; paired-or-odd game call `ز ك و:B005/m02`; reciprocal contest `ج ز ي:B005/m01`; shared stake `ش ر ك:B001/m03`; gathering and joining `ك ت ب:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The container gathers equivalent markers, shared participation supplies the stake, and contest determines whose lot prevails. Joining here is literal collection before chance divides the outcome.

parent_channels.name: S3. Side-by-Side Milking and Second-Place Accompaniment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Two milkers occupy ranked sides of an animal while supporting roles echo the second horse or answering voice.
parent_channels.active_motifs: side-positioned milker `ب ي ن:B009/m01`; milk flow `ر س ل:B006/m01`; newly delivered ewe `ر ب ب:B009/m01`; second horse `ص ل و:B006/m01`; following voice `ت ل و:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The concrete center is milking: a recently delivered ewe, flowing milk, and a second person positioned at the side. Horse and answering singer extend the scene by the same relational role of accompanying a principal from second position.

parent_channels.name: S4. Proper Names and Designated Places
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Lexical material is fixed as the name of a person, mountain, settlement, or star pair.
parent_channels.active_motifs: mountain name `ر ض و:B007/m01`; woman's name `ر ض و:B007/m02`; alternate mountain name `ر ض ي:B003/m01`; alternate woman's name `ر ض ي:B003/m02`; poet's name `ن ه ر:B007/m01`; place name `ن ه ر:B007/m02`; star names `ن ه ر:B007/m03`; personal name Salih `ص ل ح:B004/m01`; place names `ص ل ح:B005/m01`; Adnan proper name `ع د ن:B008/m01`; adjectival nisba `ع د ن:B008/m02`
parent_channels.synthesis: Naming freezes a lexical possibility into a stable referent. The scene spans persons, terrain, and stars but retains one discourse operation: designation that permits later identification.

parent_channels.name: S5. Poetic Strangeness and Lasting Notoriety
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A strange word or stray rhyme enters circulation and is remembered like an extraordinary deed.
parent_channels.active_motifs: strange wandering word `ء ب د:B008/m01`; stray rhyme or poetic line `ء ب د:B008/m02`; memorable extraordinary event `ء ب د:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Verbal strangeness makes a line detach from ordinary usage, while enduring memory gives it cultural persistence. The event and the expression meet in the capacity to remain mentioned long after their first occurrence.
